name: pl_backup_per_table
description: Backup pipeline: 45 tables, 15 waves, shared-first optimization. Phase 0: Shared tables (RefMaster + InvoiceDetail) run ONCE. Phase 1: Forecast unique. Phase 2: Inventory unique. Same wave = parallel, between waves = sequential.
optimization: Shared tables (ReferenceMaster_Enh 11t + InvoiceDetailLineLevel) run once in Phase 0. Each mart only refreshes unique tables. Eliminates ~12 redundant calls vs naive approach.

phase_1_forecast_accuracy: Silver W02 ∥∥ ActualDemandMonthly, ActualDemandWeekly, InvoiceWeekly, ForecastDemandMonthly, OpenOrderMonthly
phase_2_inventory_health: Silver W02 ∥∥ PO, MO(inc), Transfer(inc), ForecastSnapshot, SupplyPlan, ItemBalance, SafetyStock
Silver W03 ∥∥ AFIStatus, AwdHelper, LastInvoice, Cogs52W

no_new_objects: No new SPs, views, or tables created. Uses existing ETL_Framework.DW_Developer.usp_RefreshCuratedTableFromView and usp_IncrementalTableLoad.
